references.text: Moses emphasizes the importance of keeping God's commands and statutes, which will give wisdom and insight for other nations to see.
The command to keep all of God's commands and not turn from them, so that they may prosper in everything they do.
Joshua receives the same exhortation to carefully keep the law so that he may prosper and act wisely wherever he goes.
The promise of prosperity and success is tied to meditating on and keeping the words of the law.
The blessings that come with keeping God's laws and statutes and acting according to them.
The exhortation to keep all the commands in order to live and prosper in the promised land.
Solomon receives a similar exhortation to keep the Lord's commands so that he may prosper in everything he does.
The blessed man who finds joy in the Lord's law and meditates on it day and night will prosper.
The exhortation not to forget the teaching, but to keep the commands in one's heart in order to have a long life and prosperity.
